snippet.title: Obunga | Official Trailer | Nextbot Inspired Horror Game #obunga #nextbots #horrorgaming
snippet.description:
OFFICIAL TRAILER for Obunga.
#obunga #nextbots #horrorgaming

Get Obunga HERE:
ITCH.IO: https://bonniedev.itch.io/obunga
GAMEJOLT: https://gamejolt.com/games/obunga/654632

(Yes, I know this trailer is very late.)

Story:
You're trapped in a giant maze. There's only one way out, but it's locked. Find all six keys to unlock the exit door and escape before Obunga catches you.

Obunga is an indie horror game developed by me, BonnieDev. The game came up as an idea after me and a few of my friends were messing around with Nextbot NPCs in Garry's Mod. This game aims to mimic a type of game we created in Garry's Mod where we would run around a giant maze with a Nextbot chasing us.

DISCLAIMER: Obunga is the first game I've ever created so it definitely isn't perfect.

Please LIKE, COMMENT, SHARE, and SUBSCRIBE!

FOLLOW ME ON TWITTER HERE!:
https://twitter.com/dev_bonnie
